sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 5XL+.
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by S.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 6XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
